title: Bleeding Edge Alert! Deep Factorization Machines

cues.en: It's time for another bleeding edge alert!
cues.zh: 又到前沿研究提醒。

cues.en: This is where we talk about some recent research that has promising results but hasn't made it into the mainstream with recommender systems yet.
cues.zh: 這裡談近期有潛力，尚未成為主流的推薦研究。

cues.en: If you remember back to the matrix factorization section of this course, we mentioned factorization machines toward the end of it.
cues.zh: 記得矩陣分解一節，最後提到分解機。

cues.en: They are a more general form of matrix factorization, and can be designed to do the same thing as SVD as an example.
cues.zh: 它是更一般的矩陣分解形式，例如能設計來做與 SVD 相同事情。

cues.en: But they take in categorical data, and can find latent relationships between any combination of the features they are given.
cues.zh: 但接受類別資料，找出給定特徵任意組合的潛在關係。

cues.en: As such, factorization machines are more general purpose than SVD, and can sometimes find relationships between features that SVD wouldn't have considered.
cues.zh: 因此，比 SVD 通用，有時能找到 SVD 不考慮的特徵關係。

cues.en: The idea of deep factorization machines is to combine the power of factorization machines, with the power of deep neural networks, to create an even more powerful recommender system.
cues.zh: 深度分解機的概念，是結合分解機與深度神經網路力量，建立更強推薦系統。

cues.en: This hybrid approach outperforms factorization machines or neural networks used individually, albeit not by a huge margin.
cues.zh: 混合方法，勝過個別使用兩者，雖然幅度不大。

cues.en: This research is just from 2017, so it hasn't really been proven in large-scale, production use yet that we know of.
cues.zh: 研究才在 2017 年，據我們所知，尚未驗證大規模正式環境用途。

cues.en: I'll give you a brief overview of how it works, but if you want all the details, hunt down the paper it's called DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
cues.zh: 簡單概述，想看細節，可找 DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction，

cues.en: from a team at the Harbin Institute of Technology in China.
cues.zh: 來自中國哈爾濱工業大學團隊。

cues.en: It's also easy to find legitimate, free copies of the paper online.
cues.zh: 很容易在線上找到合法免費論文。

cues.en: The motivation behind DeepFM is to combine the strengths of factorization machines and deep neural networks.
cues.zh: DeepFM 動機，是結合分解機與深度神經網路優點。

cues.en: While factorization machines can uncover what we call higher-order feature interactions, they're best at lower-order feature interactions, but deep neural networks excel at higher-order interactions.
cues.zh: 分解機雖能發現高階特徵交互作用，但最擅長低階；深度神經網路，則擅長高階。

cues.en: DeepFM promises us the best of both worlds.
cues.zh: DeepFM 承諾兼得兩者優點。

cues.en: What do we mean by high or low order feature interactions?
cues.zh: 高階、低階交互作用，是什麼？

cues.en: Let's look at a couple of examples given in the paper.
cues.zh: 看看論文兩個例子。

cues.en: Imagine we're building a recommender system for an app store that recommends which app a user should download right now.
cues.zh: 想像替應用程式商店做推薦，推薦使用者現在該下載什麼。

cues.en: A food delivery app for example, might be more popular in the early evening, when it's dinner time.
cues.zh: 例如，外送應用在傍晚晚餐時間，可能更熱門。

cues.en: In this example, the features involved are order-2: there is a latent relationship between application category, food delivery apps, and the user's local time of day.
cues.zh: 這是二階特徵：應用類別，也就是外送，與使用者當地時間，有潛在關係。

cues.en: Factorizations of the user data that split out these features would work well.
cues.zh: 把這些特徵分離的使用者資料分解，效果會很好。

cues.en: Let's also consider the case of a male teenager.
cues.zh: 再看青少年男性。

cues.en: Perhaps the data supports a latent relationship between being male, being a teenager, and liking first-person-shooter games.
cues.zh: 也許資料支持：男性、青少年、喜歡第一人稱射擊遊戲，三者有潛在關係。

cues.en: In this case, we have a order-3 feature interactions.
cues.zh: 這是三階交互作用。

cues.en: The three features involved are the application category shooter games, the user's gender, and the user's age.
cues.zh: 三個特徵，是射擊遊戲類別、性別、年齡。

cues.en: The food delivery app is an example of where a factorization machine may do well, and the shooter game is a case where a deep learning network might do better.
cues.zh: 外送例子，可能適合分解機；射擊遊戲，可能適合深度學習。

cues.en: DeepFM tries to combine both approaches, so we can get good results in both low and high order cases.
cues.zh: DeepFM 試圖結合，在低、高階都有好結果。

cues.en: As an aside, the idea of an algorithm recommending shooter games to you just because you're a male teenager may rub some people the wrong way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，只因為是青少年男性，就推薦射擊遊戲，可能讓人不舒服。

cues.en: And this is in fact an example of how recommender systems can have unintended consequences this system would continue to perpetuate the stereotype of young males enjoying violent content,
cues.zh: 這也顯示，推薦系統可能有非預期後果：持續強化年輕男性喜愛暴力內容的刻板印象，

cues.en: and encourage it to continue by putting more violent content in front of young men.
cues.zh: 並展示更多暴力內容，鼓勵它持續。

cues.en: That's a much bigger ethical discussion that I'd love to have, but in short, it's important to remember that recommender algorithms can perpetuate the same biases that exist
cues.zh: 這是更大的倫理議題，我很想討論；但簡單說，要記得，推薦演算法可能延續訓練資料中

cues.en: in the data they were trained with, and even amplify them.
cues.zh: 既有偏差，甚至放大。

cues.en: It's something to be aware of and watch out for.
cues.zh: 需要了解、留意。

cues.en: This figure from the paper gives an overview of their architecture.
cues.zh: 論文這張圖，概述架構。

cues.en: You can see it's a fairly straightforward hybrid approach, the same feature data from your training set is fed in parallel to both a factorization machine, and to a deep neural network,
cues.zh: 很直接的混合方法，相同訓練特徵，平行送入分解機與深度神經網路，

cues.en: in this example, with two hidden layers.
cues.zh: 這個例子，有兩個隱藏層。

cues.en: The outputs from the factorization machine and the deep neural network are combined into the final sigmoid unit that predicts a click, purchase, or whatever action you're trying to predict.
cues.zh: 兩者輸出，結合到最後 Sigmoid，預測點擊、購買或目標行為。

cues.en: You can see visually here that the factorization machine is wide, and as such, is adept at finding lower-order feature relationships, while the neural network is deep,
cues.zh: 圖中，分解機很寬，擅長低階關係；神經網路很深，

cues.en: and adept at finding higher-order relationships.
cues.zh: 擅長高階關係。

cues.en: The idea is that they are better together, but of course how much so depends on the nature of your data and what sort of latent relationships between features really exist in it.
cues.zh: 概念是，一起更好，但程度取決於資料性質，以及真正存在什麼潛在關係。

cues.en: DeepFM may strike you as an overly complex approach, but it's really just an example of an ensemble approach for recommendations.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得 DeepFM 太複雜，但其實只是推薦集成方法的例子。

cues.en: It's combining together two different algorithms that are powerful on their own, factorization machines, and deep neural networks.
cues.zh: 結合兩個各自強大的演算法：分解機與深度神經網路。

cues.en: Think of them as two different instruments that sound even better when they're together.
cues.zh: 像兩種樂器，合奏更好聽。

cues.en: You can create a complex system by combining together many simpler ones, and usually the end result is better than using any individual algorithm in isolation.
cues.zh: 能結合多個簡單系統，建立複雜系統，最後通常比任何單一演算法更好。

cues.en: Ensemble systems, when designed properly, can make that complexity manageable by keeping its component systems largely isolated and running in parallel, and just combining their results in the end.
cues.zh: 設計得當，集成系統能讓複雜度可管理：各元件大致獨立、平行，最後只結合結果。

cues.en: That way, if any one component goes haywire, you can just disable it and the system will keep on running using the other components.
cues.zh: 其中一個出問題，只要停用，其他仍持續運作。

cues.en: So is DeepFM really bleeding edge?
cues.zh: DeepFM 真的算前沿嗎？

cues.en: Well, it's actually just combining two technologies that have been proven, so this gives me more confidence in the idea.
cues.zh: 其實只是結合兩個已驗證技術，因此我更有信心。

cues.en: Whether it produces meaningful gains in real world scenarios though remains to be shown, but I think it's worth experimenting with.
cues.zh: 真實世界是否有實質提升，尚待證明，但值得實驗。

cues.en: Remember the Netflix Prize was won with a very similar hybrid approach.
cues.zh: 記得，Netflix Prize 就用類似混合方法獲勝。

cues.en: Netflix learned that combining SVD with RBM worked really well, and DeepFM is really just taking that up a notch.
cues.zh: Netflix 發現 SVD 加 RBM 很好，DeepFM 只是再升級。

cues.en: It replaces SVD with the more general Factorization Machine model, and RBMs with a more general deep neural network.
cues.zh: 用更通用的分解機取代 SVD，更通用的深度神經網路取代 RBM。

cues.en: It's really the same concept as one that has been proven at Netflix, which makes DeepFM all the more appealing.
cues.zh: 與 Netflix 已驗證概念相同，因此更有吸引力。

cues.en: So keep an eye out for DeepFM, and if you're already an industry researcher, give it a try.
cues.zh: 所以，留意 DeepFM，如果已在業界研究，試試看。
